items.title: 6.1 Definition and Overview of Emerging Technologies (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Technology bohat tezi se badal rahi hai. Naye tareeqe aur nayi ijaadein (innovations) musalsal yeh badal rahi hain ke hum digital duniya se kaise kaam lete hain. Yeh chapter hamare zamane ki do sab se bara farq lane wali technologies parhata hai: Cloud Computing aur Blockchain.

Pehle hum Cloud Computing ki bunyadi baatein dekhenge, jaise virtualization, scalability aur on-demand access. Phir cloud services ki qismein dekhenge: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS) aur Software as a Service (SaaS). Phir cloud deployment models (cloud ko istemal mein lane ke tareeqe) dekhenge: public, private, hybrid aur multi-cloud. In bunyadi baaton se samajh aayega ke mukhtalif industries mein cloud computing kaise kaam aati hai aur us ke kya asraat (implications) hain.

Is ke baad hum Blockchain Technology par aayenge: us ke bunyadi usool (principles) aur hisse (components), jaise peer-to-peer network jo blockchain ke decentralized (kisi ek markaz ke baghair) dhaanche ki reerh ki haddi hai. Hum dekhenge ke blockchain kahan kaam aata hai, cryptocurrencies aur smart contracts mein us ka kya kirdar hai, aur product tracking, financial services aur data security mein us ke istemal aur asraat kya hain.

Chapter ke aakhir mein in technologies ke future trends (aane wale rujhanat) dekhe jayenge: edge computing, serverless architectures, aur blockchain ki agli nasal jise aksar Blockchain 2.0 and beyond kaha jata hai.
6.1 Emerging Technologies ki tareef aur jaiza

Emerging technologies woh naye tools, systems aur tareeqe hain jo abhi ban rahe hain ya jin ka istemal abhi abhi shuru hua hai. Yeh technologies hamare rehne, kaam karne aur duniya se rabta rakhne ka andaaz badal sakti hain. Kuch aham emerging technologies yeh hain:

items: Artificial Intelligence (AI): AI se murad aisi machines aur software hain jo insaan ki tarah soch aur seekh sakte hain. AI chehre pehchanne, baat (speech) samajhne aur faisle karne mein madad karti hai. Siri jaise smart assistants se le kar khud chalne wali gariyon (self-driving cars) tak har jagah istemal hoti hai.

Cloud Computing: Cloud computing mein log apna data aur applications apne computer ya server ki bajaye internet par rakhte aur istemal karte hain. Is se maloomat share karna, mil kar project par kaam karna aur services ko barhana aasan ho jata hai, mehnga hardware khareedne ki zaroorat nahi parti. Misalein: Google Drive, Dropbox aur Amazon Web Services (AWS).

Blockchain: Blockchain maloomat ko bohat se computers par mehfooz tareeqe se record aur share karne ka tareeqa hai, jise badalna ya hack karna taqreeban na-mumkin hai. Yeh Bitcoin jaisi cryptocurrencies ke peeche wali technology ke taur par mashhoor hai, lekin supply chains aur contracts mein bhi istemal hota hai.

Internet of Things (IoT): IoT rozmarra ki cheezon, jaise fridge, gari aur kapron tak ko, internet se jor deta hai. Yeh cheezein data bhej aur le sakti hain, jis se zindagi aasan hoti hai. Misal: smart thermostat aap ka routine seekh kar ghar ka temperature khud set kar leta hai.

Augmented Reality (AR) aur Virtual Reality (VR): AR smartphone ya ainak (glasses) ke zariye asal duniya mein digital cheezein jor deta hai. VR poori tarah virtual (banawati) mahol bana deta hai jis mein aap khaas equipment se kaam karte hain. Yeh gaming, taleem aur training mein istemal hoti hain.

5G Technology: 5G wireless technology ki agli nasal hai jo bohat tez internet aur zyada bharosemand connection deti hai. Is se mobile phones, smart devices aur AR aur VR jaisi nayi technologies behtar chalengi.

Quantum Computing: Quantum computers quantum physics ke usool istemal kar ke aam computers se kahin tez maloomat process karte hain. Yeh aise bohat mushkil masail hal kar sakte hain jo aaj ke aam computers ke liye na-mumkin hain.

Biotechnology: Biotechnology mein jaandar cheezein, jaise bacteria aur paude, istemal kar ke naye products banaye jate ya masail hal kiye jate hain. Misal: scientists is se nayi dawaiyan, behtar faslein (crops) aur mahol dost (environmentally friendly) materials bana rahe hain.

blocks.prompt: AR aur VR mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: AR asal duniya ke upar digital cheezein jorta hai (phone ya ainak se), asal duniya nazar aati rehti hai. VR asal duniya ki jagah poora virtual mahol bana deta hai, jo khaas equipment se dekha jata hai.

items: Emerging technologies: naye tools aur tareeqe jo abhi ban rahe ya naye istemal ho rahe hain.
Misalein: AI, cloud computing, blockchain, IoT, AR/VR, 5G, quantum computing, biotechnology.
Yeh chapter khaas taur par cloud computing aur blockchain parhata hai.
